name: restaurant-location-production-readiness
title: Harden restaurant current-location capture for production
description: Persist browser geolocation into restaurant latitude/longitude, reverse-geocode the current position into restaurant address fields, validate the coordinate pair at frontend and backend boundaries, and cover the flow with focused tests.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Manual testing found a real gap: browser GPS updated lat/lng but left stale street, ward, district, and city values on the restaurant form. The repository already has a hardened reverse-geocode endpoint used by the customer address page, so the manager flow should reuse it rather than add another provider or dependency.
